'''Mike Kessling HDADTJ balanced with no duel''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Mike Kessling]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-297">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/297 HDADTJ balanced with no duel], DeckTech (Michael "Troop1023" Kessling, 28 August 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/297/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/297/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018231723/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/297/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mike Kessling]]
* '''Published:''' 28 August 1999 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''HDADTJ balanced with no duel''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor HD Kessling DS 1999 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck is an all around deck that likes to adapt to what the opponent is doing.

== Original post ==

'''HDADTJ balanced with no duel'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "Troop1023" Kessling
* '''Published:''' August 28, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This deck is an all around deck that likes to adapt to what the opponent is doing.

=== Strategy ===

This deck will have a possibility of starting effects. Against the revo or a deck that starts obis hut you start with Bad Feeling. If they start hidden base you start Opresive Enforcement. Try to get Arrest Order out quickly. This deck can adapt to beat many different decks. Takes a good player to play.
